pages.title: Plain things, | made well
pages.label: Studio
pages.subtitle: Common Form is a small design studio. We make identities, books and posters for people who care how a thing is made, and we show our drawing as well as the result.

pages.title: Almond & Salt
pages.label: Identity
pages.subtitle: A neighbourhood bakery wanted to look the way it tastes: warm, plain and unhurried. We drew one mark and one wordmark, then tested every label against a loaf of bread.

blocks.title: Wordmark
blocks.caption: One circle, one baseline, set in a serif with some give.
blocks.alt: The Almond and Salt wordmark on warm paper with a small clay crescent

blocks.title: Packaging
blocks.caption: The label sits on kraft, so the bread is the loudest thing on the shelf.
blocks.alt: A kraft paper bag with a cream label carrying the wordmark

blocks.title: Construction
blocks.caption: Everything hangs from one circle and one baseline.
blocks.alt: The wordmark with construction circles and baselines drawn over it

blocks.title: Brief
blocks.caption: Five colours taken from the shop itself, and three words to hold to.
blocks.alt: Five colour swatches and the words warm, plain, unhurried

blocks.title: Type tests
blocks.caption: Three faces, one word. The first was the only one that looked baked.
blocks.alt: The words Almond and Salt set in three typefaces

pages.title: Field Notes
pages.label: Book
pages.subtitle: A year of walks, set as a book that is pleasant to carry and slow to finish. One grid, one margin, and a green that is quiet without being grey.

pages.title: Low Tide
pages.label: Exhibition
pages.subtitle: A poster for an exhibition of the shore. The whole idea is one circle sitting on one line, and where the line goes.

blocks.title: Poster
blocks.caption: The circle is the tide going out; the line is the horizon.
blocks.alt: A deep blue poster with a pale half circle on a horizon line and the title Low Tide

blocks.title: First sketch
blocks.caption: A circle and a line, drawn before anything else.
blocks.alt: A line drawing of a circle on a horizon with outlined letters

blocks.title: Studies
blocks.caption: Six places for the horizon to sit.
blocks.alt: Six small studies of a circle against a horizon at different heights

blocks.text: Common Form is three people in one room. We work on a small number of projects at a time, and we would rather finish a few things than start many.
This page is a sample for a demonstration. The studio, its clients and its projects are made up.
Begin with the room it will live in.
Draw it by hand before the screen.
Make fewer things, and finish them.
